name: Grey Assessor
languages: the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Debt Marked in Blood
Traits.text: When a creature damages the assessor, that creature becomes a debtor until the end of its next turn; the assessor's Bare Hand cannot miss a debtor, deals extra Necrotic damage to it, and a hit forces a DC 13 Strength save or the debtor drops what it holds.
Traits.clause: Whenever a creature damages the assessor, the assessor marks it as a debtor until the end of its next turn; the assessor
Traits.expresses: forcing victims to drop what they carry
Traits.expressedQuote: a hit forces a DC 13 Strength save or the debtor drops what it holds

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The assessor can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the assessor has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The assessor makes two Bare Hand attacks.

Actions.name: Bare Hand
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 17 (4d6 + 3) Necrotic damage.

lore: A tax-ghost is the revenant of a cruel assessor who died clutching the ledger of unpaid debts, and it now collects in perpetuity, wanting only to see every living hand bare.

generation.userConcept: a tax-ghost that makes you drop what you are carrying

generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
